title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The FDA approves Novo Nordisk's CagriSema by March 31, 2027

Kalshi asks approval before January 1 and before July 1, 2027. Novo 'expects a decision in the fourth quarter of 2026'; if that slips past year-end without a rejection, the usual cause is a review extension of about three months, which lands by the end of March. I put 7 parts in 10 of a first-half approval by March 31 (2 by mid-February, 5 by end-March) and 3 later.
